PerkDescription.DefaultText: Boosts estrogen levels and confers the capacity to conceive and bear children.
Gains trust more quickly and is slower to become suspicious of others.
Feels more comfortable with methodical, rather than creative activities.
Feels comfortable with most tasks, but sacrifices some creativity and stresses more easily.
Likes performing nurturing tasks, such as cooking, gardening, cleaning and taking care of animals.
